title_lines: These days I also build AI systems.
hero.lede: I’m a senior software engineer in Quito, Ecuador, and I work remotely. Since 2024 I’ve designed and run a production AI platform that turns recorded meetings into decisions, action items and risks. I build it with a small team and AI coding agents; I review their code and approve every release. Alongside it I still build iOS and Android apps, and I’ve shipped them for banking, health, high-volume restaurant ordering, Web3 and an online art marketplace.

case.title: AI meeting-intelligence platform
case.summary: A multi-tenant B2B product, in English and Spanish, that records meetings and extracts decisions, action items and risks. Each one links to the moment in the recording that supports it. It has been in daily production use in real client meetings since June 2025.
case.role: I designed the architecture and built it with a small team and Claude Code agents: backend, AI pipeline, web app, Chrome extension, iOS companion app and infrastructure. I review, test and approve the generated code and every production release.

decisions.title: Evidence gate on extraction
decisions.text: Extraction runs behind an evidence gate that prefers under-claiming: each decision, action and risk links to its source in the recording.

decisions.title: Silent screen recordings
decisions.text: A voice-presence check sends recordings without speech to a structured visual summary (timestamped steps, on-screen text and results) instead of producing a hallucinated transcript.

decisions.title: Recovering interrupted recordings
decisions.text: The server rebuilds interrupted live recordings from the streamed WebM segments, including segments that arrive without a header, and reprocesses the audio automatically.

decisions.title: Release gates
decisions.text: Blue/green Docker deployments go through host-health admission, deploy locks and exact-commit authorization. Images are built on remote compute nodes and pulled by digest.

decisions.title: Reviewing AI agents’ work
decisions.text: I review the agents’ code, designs and incident write-ups every day and leave written feedback. A change ships only with passing tests and evidence from production; the agent’s own report doesn’t count as evidence.

mobile.title: Native iOS and Android
mobile.text: Native apps for banking and trust products, a security-focused app, a health app, a high-volume restaurant ordering app, a Web3 wallet and an online art marketplace with augmented reality. It started in 2015 with an accessible learning platform for blind and visually impaired students.

highlights.text: Designed the architecture and built the platform end to end with a small team and Claude Code agents: backend, web app, Chrome extension, iOS companion app and infrastructure.
Built chunked, checkpointed Google Gemini transcription with speaker detection, and extraction of decisions, actions and risks with source links behind an evidence gate that prefers under-claiming.
Built Python/FastAPI services and Celery queues with workers across two hosts, backed by MySQL, Redis and ChromaDB vector search, with LangGraph and an MCP server for AI assistants.

Built the Google Cloud infrastructure as code with Terraform (Dec 2025 – Mar 2026): 20 reusable modules across preprod and prod for Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Memorystore, Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, Cloud Scheduler, KMS, Secret Manager, IAM, VPC, HTTPS load balancing, Cloud CDN, Artifact Registry and Cloud Storage.
Operated blue/green Docker deployments through Jenkins with host-health admission, deploy locks and exact-commit authorization; images are built on remote compute nodes and pulled by digest.
Review AI coding agents’ code, designs and incident write-ups every day with detailed written feedback, and gate merges and releases on passing tests and production evidence.

Built the iOS companion app in Swift and SwiftUI: AVFoundation microphone capture, ReplayKit broadcast capture and AVKit playback; async/await with actor-isolated resumable uploads, persisted upload manifests, device-flow sign-in, Keychain storage, App Intents and unit tests.
Built a Manifest V3 Chrome extension in JavaScript that records Google Meet, Teams and Zoom, streams live audio and video chunks, signs in through device flow and retries uploads.
Built the web app with Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript and Tailwind, tested with Vitest and Playwright, with PostHog analytics.
Built isolated cloud-browser rooms streamed over WebRTC to run and record meetings, with per-room operators, a microphone guard and per-meeting attendance measurement.
Implemented server-side recovery of interrupted live recordings by reassembling streamed WebM segments, including segments missing their header, and reprocessing the recovered audio automatically.
Added a voice-presence gate so silent screen recordings receive structured visual summaries (timestamped steps, on-screen text and results) instead of hallucinated transcripts.

Built the multi-tenant product in English and Spanish with Jira, GitHub, Slack, calendar and MCP integrations, tenant-scoped view, edit, send and admin permissions, personal access tokens and consent capture.

Built live-meeting Slack status and remote controls to mute the microphone, turn off the camera and leave calls, with channel-wide authorization, audit trails and automatic post-meeting summary checks.
Built per-person daily status that reconciles Jira, Azure DevOps, Notion, Plane and GitHub data with Slack and meeting evidence.
Implemented zero-downtime deployments, traffic splitting, rollback scripts, Cloud Run health probes and a scale-to-zero office-hours mode to reduce idle cost.
Added Prometheus and Grafana alerting, Sentry/GlitchTip crash triage with deduplicated GlitchTip-to-Jira automation, and OpenBao (Vault-compatible) secrets management.
Migrated legacy Android XML layouts to Jetpack Compose with ViewModel/MVVM patterns for maintainable state and UI behavior.
Built and maintained native and cross-platform features across iOS and Android: Swift native modules, Kotlin, Flutter, and React Native features with native bridges.
Used Flutter with Dart, flutter_bloc and the Singular SDK for predictable state management, attribution and analytics.
Added WidgetKit extension targets and shared code schemes to bring app state to iOS widgets.
Worked on build configuration, dependencies and CI/CD release workflows with GitHub Actions and Tekton for repeatable mobile delivery.
Built the token-swap flow and Android features with Jetpack Compose, Hilt and the repository pattern.
Implemented chat replies and reactions, a fiat on-ramp UI and the Kotlin DSL migration in sprint work with the client’s teams.
Developed and maintained production iOS features in Swift, including augmented-reality art visualization and catalog experiences.
Built and improved AR features with ARKit and SceneKit, with attention to rendering behavior, interaction quality and performance.
Integrated REST API catalog data flows, working with designers, QA and project managers.
Managed beta and production builds, TestFlight delivery and App Store publication with QA and project stakeholders.

items.title: Client engagements for a software consultancy

highlights.text: Built features with native iOS modules in Swift and Android-facing integrations: HealthKit, deep links, push notifications, background delivery and offline-aware serialization.
Used Firebase, Sentry and PostHog for analytics, observability and production visibility across mobile releases.
Developed secure native apps in Swift and Kotlin focused on protected user workflows, fraud-aware flows and reliable communication between the app and its backend.
Integrated secure REST APIs and AWS-backed services with native modules for asynchronous workflows, data integrity and responsive user experiences.
Led Android and iOS initiatives to improve app performance and UX and to coordinate scalable, backend-connected data flows for high-volume consumer use.
Built and maintained Android features in Kotlin with modern native architecture, working with backend teams on analytics, personalization, secure data access and transaction processing.
Took part in the first Flutter experiments for cross-platform delivery, validating shared UI flows, state-management options and native-integration trade-offs.
Delivered secure mobile features for financial products on Android and iOS: Kotlin and Java, iOS support, automated testing, secure transactions and backend-connected workflows.

Designed and developed an inclusive mobile learning platform for blind and visually impaired users with Android (Java/Kotlin), tactile feedback, audio narration, accessibility-first UX and device integration.
